page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head and page number above it. Below the last line: the signature "X 2" at centre and the catchword at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: trem occidissent, si virginem rapuissent & violassent, aut quid aliud non mino-ris atrocitatis crimen commisissent; cui juris usurpationi occasionem dederunt duæ Bullæ Pontificiæ, prior à Leone X. data, qvi trinæ monitionis Clerico ve-stem Clericalem deserenti necessitatem tollit, ut omni privilegio Clericali exua-tur, necessitatem solum imponit Bullam qvotannis tribus primis qvadragesimæ Dominicis in Ecclesiis Episcopalibus le-gendi : posterior licentiam dat Regi Clericos in monetæ cusione servientes nulla habita Clericalis privilegii ratione judicandi & puniendi, cujus mentio-nem faciunt Franciscus I. in constitut. An. 1540. & Henricus II. in constituit. 1549. passim igitur Clericis minoribus à Judice Laico nulla habita ratione Cle-ricalis privilegii, non tantum amplius civiliter, sed etiam criminaliter punitis, paulatim ad Sacratos Clericos deven-tum est, si crimen aliqvod atrox contra publicam tranqvillitatem perpetrassent, v.g. si cum prædonibus, publicis viis in-

page.notes: The catchword at the foot is partly unclear; it reads as "sidem" or "fidem", so I marked it [?]. The line "trem" at the top is a fragment of a word continued from the previous page and is kept as printed. The spelling "qvi", "qvotannis", "tranqvillitatem" and "aliqvod" is printed with qv and is kept. Some letters in the scan are faint, especially in "Clericalis" and "Franciscus", but they are legible.
